function Fragment(props?): DocumentFragment;

Defined in: core/jsx.ts:159

JSX Fragment factory — groups children without a wrapper element. Returns a DocumentFragment whose children move into the parent on append (the fragment itself is empty afterwards, which is intended — MDN: the fragment's children are moved, not copied, into the insertion point).
